rule.name: Dynamic evidence-gated companion
rule.trigger: Checkpoint × HR Form band × odds band
rule.freeze: First qualifying checkpoint per player per slate; exact archived book and price are immutable.

methodology.history: Every checkpoint uses only complete, prior settled slates; the current slate never contributes to its own rule selection.
methodology.evidence_gate: Each trigger cell must independently clear all-history, trailing-30-day, and trailing-14-day gates of at least 40 settled bets, 4 wins, 5 slates, and positive net units.
methodology.weighted_return: Expected return is the settled-bet-weighted ROI across the three evidence horizons and must remain positive.
methodology.support: At least two of three broader parent slices (checkpoint × form, checkpoint × odds, form × odds) must each have at least 20 settled bets, 5 slates, and positive net units in prior history.
methodology.execution: Select every pregame player in a qualifying broad trigger cell. Book, rank, and game-time slices are supporting diagnostics only and never trigger a bet by themselves. If a player qualifies more than once, the first checkpoint wins.
methodology.staking: One flat unit per settled HR prop. No plate appearance is a void.
